# Kill any ghost processes
pkill -9 python
gpgconf --kill gpg-agent
Phase 2: The Lightweight "Direct Line"We are replacing the failing Python script with a Bash-native bridge. This uses the phone's built-in curl tool, which is much "lighter" and incredibly stable.Run this to create your new bridge:Bashcat << 'EOF' > ~/ziggy_light.sh
#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash
# Trinity Direct Line (No-Python Build)
PROMPT="${1:-System check: Are you there?}"
curl -s -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash:generateContent?key=$GEMINI_API_KEY" \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d "{'contents': [{'parts':[{'text': '$PROMPT'}]}]}" | grep -oP '"text":\s*"\K[^"]+'
EOF
